items.title: JS: `*if c { &a } else { &b }` over a SCALAR or `str` prints the place pair — `let n = 4; let m = 5; print(*if n < m { &n } else { &m })` prints `[ [ 4 ], 0 ]`
items.body: Native prints the value. B444's read-through, through a conditional (transformer.rs). F81's native pin holds aggregates only because of it. With B512 (an unannotated `let x = if c { &a } else { &b }`). Sizing S; solver, Order 46 FIRST with B511.
